name: Dawndraco
isnote: Many authors consider it a synonym of Geosternbergia/Pteranodon sternbergi; Kellner (2010) argued its stratigraphic position supports a separate genus.
sum: Controversial toothless pteranodontid from the Smoky Hill Chalk of Kansas.
holotype: UALVP 24238 — lower Smoky Hill Chalk Member, Niobrara Formation, Kansas.
material: Partial skeleton with almost complete skull and lower jaws.
biology: Lived over the Western Interior Seaway; pteranodontids were ocean-going soarers that fed on fish.
author: Kellner 2010
